title: Case Report: Navigating the bleeding-thrombosis paradox: regional nafamostat anticoagulation in a post-intracerebral hemorrhage patient on VV-ECMO
description: Figure 2 Serial chest radiographs demonstrating lung recovery during ECMO support. (A) Chest X-ray on Day 21 (ECMO initiation) showing diffuse bilateral consolidation.
